issue.title: Segfault in container (mock + systemd-nspawn)
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

TLDR: `vite build` segfaults in a [Mock](https://github.com/rpm-software-management/mock) chroot

While building [ntfy-2.25.0](https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy/releases#release-v2.25.0) on [COPR](https://copr.fedorainfracloud.org/coprs/cyqsimon/ntfysh/builds/), I noticed that all chroots are consistently erroring with status 139 (SIGSEGV) while building the web front-end with vite.

Initially I suspected it was some sort of COPR-specific problem, because there was no error on my local Arch Linux box, no error on my local EL9 server, and no error on my local Fedora VM. **But when I managed to set up a similar containerized environment locally, I was able to reproduce the segfault consistently.** I think it's because the container environment has more stringent security policy and/or allocation mechanism.

Compared to ntfy-2.24.0, a notable change in ntfy-2.25.0 was that [vite was bumped from 6 to 8](https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy/blame/6638699d4801bfeebd4582d8e6bf3d85f6901e02/web/package.json#L45). Knowing that vite 8 introduced native (Rust) code, ~~and knowing about the coincidentally very recent discovery of [an LLVM miscompilation issue](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/159035) (**note**: I'm not at all saying this is the cause or is even related)~~ (this one's unrelated), it led me to suspect an issue within some native code in vite 8 that caused the segfault.

In the POC I tested:
- Building ntfy-2.25.0 as is, using vite-8.1.0 as declared in the lockfile - segfault
- Building ntfy-2.25.0 after updating to vite-8.1.4 (latest as of writing) - segfault
- Bulding ntfy-2.25.0 after downgrading to vite-7.3.6 (latest v7 as of writing) - ok

### Reproduction

https://github.com/cyqsimon/vite-8-segfault-poc

### Steps to reproduce

Follow instructions in the POC.

Apologies in advance that I cannot create a minimal vite project source that exhibits this problem. But given the nature of this issue (and my role as just the packager) hopefully you can understand.

But I could at least cut down all the irrelevant noise from [the actual build script](https://github.com/cyqsimon/ntfysh-spec/blob/5ee7ddb7949ccc7aecdaeebecd6e60a04969a136/ntfysh.spec). Hopefully this helps a little.

### System Info

Probably not relevant but here it is anyway.

P.s. This is running outside of the mock chroot. Not sure why it says `Container: Yes`; it's a full KVM VM, not a container.

```shell

    OS: Linux 7.1 Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition)
    CPU: (8) x64 Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10710U CPU @ 1.10GHz
    Memory: 6.61 GB / 7.74 GB
    Container: Yes
    Shell: 5.3.9 - /bin/bash

    npm: 11.8.0 - /usr/bin/npm
  Browsers:
    Firefox: 152.0.4
    Firefox Developer Edition: 152.0.4
```

### Used Package Manager

npm
